item.title: Behind a dominant defense, Seattle defeated New England 29-13 to become champions Sunday.
item.description: HeraldNet.com HeraldNet.com - Everett and Snohomish County news from The Daily Herald in Everett, Washington SANTA CLARA, Calif. — It became apparent early on that the New England Patriots could do virtually nothing against a Seahawks defense that was the league’s best. Behind a dominant defense, Seattle defeated New England 29-13 to become champions Sunday. Aaron Coe

item.title: Has Trump forgotten what’s written on Lady Liberty?
